concept: ElastiCache Redis: HA session store with Multi-AZ and failover
tests: Choosing a managed, highly available cache for session state that survives node failure.
expected: ElastiCache for Redis with replication, Multi-AZ and automatic failover — sessions survive a node failure. Triggers: "session state", "survive node failures", "highly available caching layer".
why_not: Memcached — no replication/persistence; instance memory is lost with the instance; DynamoDB would work, but it isn't the caching layer the question asks for.
